annotations.title: House on a plot with pool, garage and the full report (Wai)

description: Wai's rule engine fits a villa, duplex or triplex villa (L-shaped, U round a courtyard, or compact for a small plot; optional basement) on a real plot with a swimming pool, a garage, storage and a perimeter wall or fence, and returns the report: site checks (setbacks, TAKS, KAKS, height), excavation and earthworks (m³, truck loads), the ground investigation to ask for, heat loss / gain and energy on the site climate, MEP for a house (heat pump or boiler, underfloor heating, split cooling, hot water, plumbing flows, electrical maximum demand and supply, PV potential), site hazards, the permits of the local authority (TR, RO or generic) and the bill of quantities - civil, mechanical, electrical. Cost only with the user's own unit rates (unit_rates {key: rate}, currency) - Wai gives no prices. Pre-design screening; the georeferenced IFC4 is in Wai. Answer with the returned numbers, not an estimate made before the call.

unit_rates.description: own unit rates by BoQ key, e.g. {"concrete": 120, "rebar": 900, "excavation": 8}
